description_zh: 用BatchApplyAdviceByIdList接口批量应用多条优化建议
kebab_example: aliyun adb batch-apply-advice-by-id-list --db-cluster-id am-uf6g8w25jacm70000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchApplyAdviceByIdList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data warehouse cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of data warehouse clusters
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the optimization suggestions that you want to apply. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 待批量应用的建议ID列表，多个建议ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: advice_id_list

parameters.help_en: The date when the optimization suggestions were generated. Specify the date in the `yyyyMMdd` format. The date is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 建议生成的日期。格式：yyyyMMdd（UTC时间）
parameters.name: advice_date

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to immediately start the build task
parameters.name: build_immediately

Message.description_en:
The message returned for the request.

If the request is successful, SUCCESS is returned.

If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh:
批量应用建议执行结果。取值说明：
请求正常，返回SUCCESS。 
请求异常，返回具体异常错误信息
